items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates the relationship between Louis Armstrong and Joe Glaser ('Louis remembered that he had worked for Joe Glaser', 'For 45 years he was his manager'), but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself and Glaser.

ctx.x: Every -- before Swiss Kriss he took Pluto Water, and it came in a bottle. It's strong stuff, you know. And then he got on his herbal Swiss Kriss. Later -- I think the reason Glaser helped switch him to that Swiss Kriss was it comes in little packages, and it's herbal and it's easy to carry. With that -- you know, traveling by plane all the time, carrying cases of that Pluto Water, I think Glaser was watching that bill go up --
